title: 中国北方面食②陕西油泼面：一勺滚油，泼出满碗香 | Shaanxi Oil-Splashed Noodles 🌶️🍜
description:
你能吃多辣？纯素的油泼面你打几分？评论区见 👇

【中国北方面食硬核派 · 第2集/共4集 · 泼】
陕西油泼面：一碗面的高潮在最后一步。宽面上铺满辣椒面、葱花、蒜末和花椒，油烧到八九成热，一勺浇下——“呲啦”一声，香味瞬间被激醒。趁热搅开，油亮酸辣。面宽得像裤带，是“陕西十大怪”里的“面条像裤带”。没有一片肉，也能香到跺脚。

Shaanxi oil-splashed noodles (you po mian): the climax is the very last step. Chili flakes, scallion, garlic and Sichuan pepper are heaped on wide belt-like noodles, then near-smoking oil is ladled over — one loud sizzle, and the aroma wakes up at once. Toss it hot: glossy, tangy, fiery. The noodles are as wide as a belt — one of Shaanxi’s “ten oddities.” No meat, still foot-stomping good.
